summary: First testing run of MediBridge platform. Tested all 4 role logins, dashboards, appointments, consultation records, pre-consultation, verification, availability, registration, and logout flows. 19/19 backend tests pass. Frontend is mostly working with one notable bug in the doctor verification page.

minor.issue: Returns {status: 'not_submitted'} for demo approved doctors because it only checks the `verifications` collection (which has no seeded records), not the user's verification_status field. The user record has verification_status='approved' but the verifications collection has no document for demo professionals.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'Verification Status: Not Submitted' for Dr. James Wilson who is already approved. The page fetches from /api/professionals/verification which returns 'not_submitted' because the verifications collection has no seed data for demo doctors. Doctor dashboard correctly shows 'Verified' badge using user.verification_status.

issues: Should display 'Approved' status for demo doctors but shows 'Not Submitted'

action_items: Fix /api/professionals/verification GET endpoint to return user.verification_status as fallback when no verifications document exists. OR seed a verifications document for demo professionals during seeding with status='approved'.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/professionals/verification only checks the verifications collection but not the user.verification_status field - creates mismatch for seeded demo accounts
Server.py is 1010 lines and should be split into route modules for maintainability
JWT_SECRET falls back to insecure default - should raise error if not set in production

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all core flows working, 1 UI data bug in verification page)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows tested and working: role selection, login/logout for all 4 roles, patient dashboard, doctor dashboard with Verified badge, appointments with View Record, consultation record with e-prescription, pre-consultation AI start screen, availability slots, registration. One bug: doctor/professional verification page shows 'Not Submitted' instead of 'Approved' for demo doctors. Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_medibridge.py - note the correct endpoints are /api/professionals/list (not /api/professionals), /api/availability/my (not /api/availability), /api/consultations/{id} (not /api/appointments/{id}/record), and e-prescription key is e_prescription (not eprescription).
rca_of_issue: RCA for verification page showing 'Not Submitted': The GET /api/professionals/verification endpoint at line 305-309 in server.py only looks up the verifications collection (db.verifications.find_one), which contains documents created when a professional manually submits verification credentials. Demo seed accounts get approved directly via user.verification_status='approved' in the users collection but no corresponding document is inserted into verifications collection. Fix: Either (a) also create a verification document during seeding, or (b) modify the GET endpoint to check user.verification_status as a fallback when no verification document exists.
